name: Eyewear (Modern)
tagline: A modern, working storefront for a direct-to-consumer eyewear brand.
description: A complete, working shop for a direct-to-consumer eyewear brand: a real catalogue of optical frames (each in its own colourways with a lens choice), sunglasses, a blue-light pair, reading glasses, a free home try-on kit and a care accessory, with categories, collections, a bespoke eyewear PDP and a fully merchandised home page. Modern fashion-optical theme — crisp warm-neutral paper, a deep-teal primary, a warm tortoise accent. Shipped as Frame & Lens.
